ideas.name: Beat Pads
ideas.approachWhy: The fun is in rhythm patterns (on-beat, off-beat, waltz, speed-up) that have to feel musical; hand-made patterns sound right, random ones sound like noise. The existing shrink motion makes each one cheap to build.

have: shrink motion: pads breathe between full size and `min` on a period and phase, played at server time
flip motion, for the Beat and Flip mix
per-pad period and phase, so off-beat, waves and speed-ups are just numbers
gap and rise tests at rest (gap at most 6, rise at most 3.5, measured at full size)

new.what: shuttle easing for shrink: snap to full size on the beat, hold, then shrink, instead of a smooth wave, so 'on the beat' is a clear moment. Same hold-move-hold curve as idea 25's 'shuttle' slide; build it once and use it for both

BeatClock: a client beat clock that plays drum ticks in time with server time and can mute bars (Silent Bar). Other ideas that tick before a change (1, 11, 21, 25, 28, 29) can hang their tick on it too
the closing ring: a glowing ring that shrinks onto each pad and meets its edge on the beat (visual only, like idea 10's glow-only motion)
hazard touch = back to the start pad (shared with ideas 1, 8, 25), used for the red goo plate under pads in Goo Heartbeat

tempo steps inside one section (Speed Up, Rush Climb): later pads use a shorter period that still fits the bar, so the beat stays in time. Set by position, not by how long you wait (unlike idea 1's speed-up controller)
Night Groove only: reuse idea 17's Darkness controller; no new night system

ideas.readability: Beat pads are pink, glow and pulse to a drum tick; a ring closes onto each pad and touches its edge on the beat, when it is full size. Shrunk pads look faint and see-through. In Night Groove the beat glow is the only light, so the cue is the same one.

variants.name: Four on the Floor
variants.does: Every pad grows together on the same slow beat, so you just hop pad to pad each time the ring closes.
variants.numbers: 5 pads 10 wide, 4 stud gaps, beat every 3 s, shrinks to 50%

variants.name: Ping Pong
variants.does: Pads take turns: the next pad swells as yours shrinks, so you jump on every beat to keep up.
variants.numbers: 6 pads 10 wide, 4 stud gaps, 2 groups half a beat apart, 3.2 s

variants.name: Soft Beat
variants.does: Pads only breathe down to about two thirds, so a late landing is still safe; it teaches the ring cue.
variants.numbers: 4 pads 10 wide, 5 stud gaps, 3.6 s beat, min 65%

variants.name: Drum Rest
variants.does: A big steady drum pad that never shrinks sits after every two beat pads, so you can stop and listen again.
variants.numbers: 2 beat pads, drum, 2 beat pads; pads 9 wide, drum 14 wide, 4 stud gaps, 3 s

variants.name: Backwave
variants.does: The wave of growing pads rolls toward you, against your way, so you hop onto each pad just as the swell reaches it instead of riding along.
variants.numbers: 7 pads 9 wide, 4 stud gaps, each a quarter beat before the one behind it, 3 s beat

variants.name: Off-Beat Hop
variants.does: Pads grow on the 'and' between beats: the ring and the drum still mark the beat, so you jump in the gaps between them.
variants.numbers: 5 pads 9 wide, 5 stud gaps, 2.8 s beat, pads half a beat late

variants.name: Speed Up
variants.does: The tempo rises along the section, from a slow beat at the start to a quick one at the end, so you must keep up.
variants.numbers: 6 pads 9 wide, 4 stud gaps, beat 3.2 s, then 2.4 s, then 1.8 s

variants.name: Waltz
variants.does: A three-beat bar: pad 1, 2 and 3 grow in turn, and pad 3 is a step up, so you count one-two-three as you climb.
variants.numbers: 6 pads 9 wide, 4 stud gaps, 3 beats of 1 s, every third pad 2.5 studs higher

variants.name: Hold and Hurry
variants.does: A syncopated pattern: one pad stays big for two beats, then the next two flash by fast, so you wait, then run.
variants.numbers: 1 long pad (2 beats) then 2 short pads (half a beat each), twice; 9 wide, 4 stud gaps, 2.6 s

variants.name: Beat Stairs
variants.does: The pads climb like a staircase and each one grows on the beat, so every jump is up and on time.
variants.numbers: 6 pads 9 wide, 3 stud gaps, each 3 studs higher, 3 s beat

variants.name: Zigzag Groove
variants.does: Pads swing from the left edge of the lane to the right, so each on-beat jump is also a sideways jump.
variants.numbers: 6 pads 9 wide, 5 stud diagonal gaps, 7 studs left and right, 2.8 s

variants.name: Beat and Flip
variants.does: Beat pads are mixed with flip tiles that vanish on the off-beat, so you hear one rhythm but read two kinds of pad.
variants.numbers: beat pad, flip tile, beat pad, flip tile, beat pad; 9 wide, 4 stud gaps, 3 s, flip solid 50%

variants.name: Silent Bar
variants.does: The music drops out for one bar halfway along, so you keep time by the closing rings alone until it comes back.
variants.numbers: 6 pads 9 wide, 4 stud gaps, 3 s beat, bars 3 and 4 silent

variants.name: Double Time
variants.does: A quick beat with pads that shrink almost to nothing, so you land right on the beat and jump again straight away.
variants.numbers: 6 pads 8 wide, 5 stud gaps, 1.6 s beat, min 10%

variants.name: Goo Heartbeat
variants.does: Each pad sits on a red goo plate: on the beat the pad covers it, off the beat the goo shows round your feet, so stay in the middle.
variants.numbers: 5 pads 10 wide on 10 wide goo plates, 4 stud gaps, 2.4 s beat, shrinks to 35%

variants.name: Two Drummers
variants.does: Two rows of pads side by side keep different beats (3 and 4 per bar), and you cross between rows when they line up.
variants.numbers: 2 rows of 6 pads 9 wide, row A 3 beats, row B 4 beats per 4 s bar, 4 stud gaps

variants.name: Rush Climb
variants.does: Stairs that speed up: every pad is higher and the beat gets quicker as you climb, ending at 1.6 s.
variants.numbers: 7 pads 8 wide, 4 stud gaps, each 3 studs higher, beat 2.8 s down to 1.6 s

variants.name: Night Groove
variants.does: The section goes dark (borrowed from Lights Out): pads only light up on their beat, so you see where to land only in the moment it is safe.
variants.numbers: 6 pads 9 wide, 4 stud gaps, 2.6 s beat, pads glow 0.8 s of each beat, shrink to 30%
